note: The machine-readable rendering of PROFILE_DURABLE_SESSION_HOST.md section P8. A PLACEMENT profile (core section 8.6): it registers no vocabulary by construction, so this file carries no tokens or nodeKinds block and no reference to one. The vocabulary is whichever vocabulary profile the composition's root belongs to; naming one here would make this placement move whenever that profile moves.

composesWith.rule: the vocabulary profile the composition's root belongs to: the one whose appRoot.base vocabulary registers the root's base token (core section 8.6)
composesWith.note: A token, node kind, composition rule or refusal class of that vocabulary profile applies here unchanged. What this placement adds is its facet declaration below, and nothing a decoder owes.
